title: fuse-flow gate
description: What must hold before a step counts as done.

anyOf.description: The owner-action gate as a mapping: `owner-action: …`, optionally with `description` and `route_back_to`.

owner-action.description: The owner does what this text says, for example approve the design. Engine effect: the step waits for the owner (AWAITING_OWNER) when it is continued, until `fuse-flow continue <slug> --owner-approved`.

description.description: What the gate is for, in free text, for the reader. Engine effect: none.

route_back_to.description: The steps the work should go back to when this gate cannot be passed: one step id or a list, each this step or one before it. Usually the step that produces the artifact the gate finds fault with. Engine effect: when the step awaits the owner or is blocked, fuse-flow suggests these steps for `--back-to`, and the viewer draws them as routes back.

anyOf.description: The check gate as a mapping: `check: …`, optionally with `description` and `route_back_to`.

check.description: A kind of check, a single lower-case word such as `default`, which the project's policy binds to a command (checks: { default: bun run check }). Engine effect: the bound command runs from the repository root when the step is continued, and `continue` is refused unless it exits 0. An unbound kind refuses the step and tells the agent to find the command and record it; a kind bound to `none` passes.

description.description: What the gate is for, in free text, for the reader. Engine effect: none.

route_back_to.description: The steps the work should go back to when this gate cannot be passed: one step id or a list, each this step or one before it. Usually the step that produces the artifact the gate finds fault with. Engine effect: when the step awaits the owner or is blocked, fuse-flow suggests these steps for `--back-to`, and the viewer draws them as routes back.

anyOf.description: The script gate as a mapping: `script: …`, optionally with `description` and `route_back_to`.

script.description: A shell command, run from the repository root when the step is continued. Engine effect: `continue` is refused unless the command exits 0.

description.description: What the gate is for, in free text, for the reader. Engine effect: none.

route_back_to.description: The steps the work should go back to when this gate cannot be passed: one step id or a list, each this step or one before it. Usually the step that produces the artifact the gate finds fault with. Engine effect: when the step awaits the owner or is blocked, fuse-flow suggests these steps for `--back-to`, and the viewer draws them as routes back.

anyOf.description: The agent gate as a mapping: `agent: …`, optionally with `max_rounds`, `guide`, `description` and `route_back_to`.

agent.description: What an independent agent reviews. The agent that did the work classifies each finding as fix required or false positive, fixes what is required, and they repeat until a round ends with no required fix, or as the review guide says. Engine effect: none; the text, the review guide and the round cap are printed with the step, and the agent that did the work counts the rounds.

description.description: What the gate is for, in free text, for the reader. Engine effect: none.

route_back_to.description: The steps the work should go back to when this gate cannot be passed: one step id or a list, each this step or one before it. Usually the step that produces the artifact the gate finds fault with. Engine effect: when the step awaits the owner or is blocked, fuse-flow suggests these steps for `--back-to`, and the viewer draws them as routes back.

max_rounds.description: How many review rounds that end with a required fix the step allows; 2 unless the workflow or policy says otherwise. When the cap is reached, the agent that did the work does not start another round; it runs `fuse-flow continue <slug> --blocked "<why>"`. Engine effect: none; fuse-flow prints the cap, raised by any rounds the owner granted, and does not count the rounds.

guide.description: A review guide for this gate, relative to the workflow file or absolute. It replaces the review guides of the step's artifacts and decides what counts as a required fix and when a round passes. A project's policy or its own library can replace it. Engine effect: printed with the step.
